visualDefinition: ONE countable visual = one distinct diagram or animation scene (1), one data or derivation table (1), or one chart/plot (1). Do NOT count: title cards, plain text or a lone formula, decorative backgrounds, watermarks, presenter/avatar overlays, or browser/player chrome.
